title: The shape and text settings reach everything you picked
goal: The same gap one section further down. Pick three labels and the text settings vanish, so making them all 14 point is three trips; pick two arrows and the shape settings vanish. Both sections should speak for the whole selection the way the colors do, and say where the picked layers disagree.
notes: Follows the Effects and Shadow task and should reuse whatever mixed-value plumbing that one lands. Same cause: LayersPanel.swift availableSections inserts .annotation and .text only inside `if let layer = selectedLayer`. TextInspector (line 1828) and AnnotationInspector (line 1638) both take one Layer. Note the text restyle path already re-measures the frame (EditorState.restyleSelectedText), so doing it for several layers means several re-measures inside one History.perform. AnnotationContent settings differ per shape, so the section should offer the intersection of what the picked shapes have rather than everything.
acceptance: With several text layers picked, the text settings are in the panel and a font, size or weight set there reaches all of them in one undo step
With several shapes picked, their settings are in the panel and thickness or corner settings reach all of them in one undo step
A setting the picked layers disagree on reads as mixed, and setting it makes them agree
A selection holding a mix of kinds shows only the settings the picked layers actually share
Try it: type three labels, band-select them, and set the size once
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task

log.note: deps set to the Effects and Shadow task by the manager pass
